title: Metabolomic fingerprinting, molecular modelling and experimental bioprospection of Helianthus annuus seed cultivars as Pseudomonas aeruginosa LasR modulators.
authors: Raghoonanadan, Akshay; Dweba, Yamkela; Aruwa, Christiana E; Sabiu, Saheed
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用代谢组学、分子对接和动力学模拟筛选向日葵种子代谢物作为细菌LasR蛋白（非DNA结合）的调节剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，与TF-DNA互作课题无关。
abstract: The Pseudomonas aeruginosa LasR quorum sensing system (QSS) is central to regulating the expression of several pathogenicity factors. Also, while seed- and/or plant-derived products have been investigated as QSS regulators, the impact of Helianthus annuus (Pannar sunflower seed cultivars) extracts and metabolites as LasR modulators remain underexplored. Thus, this study focused on the untargeted metabolomic profiling (Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry), in vitro and in silico (docking, pharmacokinetics, dynamic simulation) bioprospection of Pannar seed cultivars' extracts and metabolites as LasR modulators. The extracts showed significant QS modulating properties (motility, violacein, biofilm, cell attachment, pyocyanin inhibition) with the PAN 7102 CLP seed cultivar (74.3 %) being the most potent, compared to azithromycin (65 %) and cinnamaldehyde (62 %). Chemometric principal component analysis (PCA) analysis showed distinct metabolite signatures with 52.5 % variance across the six cultivars that was driven by aqueous and ethanolic extracts of PAN 7102, 7160, and 7156 cultivars. The presence of methoxymellein, hydroxytetradecanedioic acid, koninginin G, geoside, pinellic acid and methylpicraquassioside A were reported for the first time. The profiled metabolites were subjected to a 100-ns molecular dynamics simulation following molecular docking. Binding free energy (DeltaG(bind)) calculations revealed obolactone (-48.26 kcal/mol), 1,4-bis(phenylglyoxaloyl)benzene (-45.06 kcal/mol), cyclocanaliculatin (-43.41 kcal/mol), 5-hydroxy-7-methoxy-2-phenylchroman-4-one (-39.18 kcal/mol) and lonchocarpin (-33.78 kcal/mol) as first-time putative leads relative to azithromycin (-32.09 kcal/mol). All lead metabolites also conformed to Lipinski's rule of 5 (Ro5), and their LasR bound complexes were thermodynamically stable and compact given their strong bond interactions. Findings indicate that metabolomic profiling remain key to identifying new compounds from underexplored species. H. annuus lead metabolites and extracts may also play key roles as LasR modulators. Further structural modification of the 5 leads could aid their development into novel, oral therapeutics targeting LasR to mitigate resistant P. aeruginosa infections.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌LasR群体感应系统（QSS）在调控多种致病因子表达中起核心作用。此外，尽管种子和/或植物来源的产物已被研究作为QSS调节剂，但向日葵（Pannar向日葵种子品种）提取物及其代谢物作为LasR调节剂的影响仍未充分探索。因此，本研究聚焦于Pannar种子品种提取物及代谢物作为LasR调节剂的非靶向代谢组学分析（液相色谱-质谱联用）、体外和计算机模拟（分子对接、药代动力学、动态模拟）生物勘探。提取物显示出显著的QS调节特性（运动性、紫色杆菌素、生物膜、细胞附着、绿脓菌素抑制），其中PAN 7102 CLP种子品种（74.3%）效力最强，相比阿奇霉素（65%）和肉桂醛（62%）。化学计量学主成分分析（PCA）显示，六个品种间存在显著代谢物特征差异，方差为52.5%，主要由PAN 7102、7160和7156品种的水提物和乙醇提物驱动。甲氧基蜂蜜曲霉素、羟基十四碳二酸、koninginin G、geoside、pinellic acid和methylpicraquassioside A的存在为首次报道。在分子对接后，对已分析的代谢物进行了100纳秒的分子动力学模拟。结合自由能（DeltaG(bind)）计算揭示obolactone（-48.26 kcal/mol）、1,4-双(苯基乙二醛酰)苯（-45.06 kcal/mol）、cyclocanaliculatin（-43.41 kcal/mol）、5-羟基-7-甲氧基-2-苯基色满-4-酮（-39.18 kcal/mol）和lonchocarpin（-33.78 kcal/mol）为首次发现的推定先导化合物，相对于阿奇霉素（-32.09 kcal/mol）。所有先导代谢物也符合Lipinski五规则（Ro5），其LasR结合复合物在强键相互作用下热力学稳定且结构紧凑。研究结果表明，代谢组学分析仍是识别未充分探索物种中新化合物的关键。H. annuus先导代谢物和提取物也可能在作为LasR调节剂方面发挥关键作用。对5个先导化合物的进一步结构修饰可能有助于将其开发为靶向LasR的新型口服治疗药物，以缓解耐药性铜绿假单胞菌感染。
